items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Yes, Bill Robinson, Bo Jangles he gave me that little tip how to move around you know, do that little dance.

ctx.x: move my shoulders and so forth. So after the first show Bill Robinson says, hey kid, come here. I'm going to put you into something he says. When you're doing that song out there, and there were no microphones in those days you know, this was a long time ago. He says, when you're doing that song out there, he says, do a little dance step while you're doing it, move around a little bit. He says, you see what happens.

And he showed me the steps, you know, just a little simple steps and I was very apt you know. I picked it up just like that the little steps that he showed me, they're nothing. And so I got out there the next show and did the number and man, it broke it up. Yes, Bill Robinson, Bo Jangles he gave me that little tip how to move around you know, do that little dance.
And you know I'd watch him with his dancing and then I got pretty cute you know. (LAUGHTER).
